resume_brief:
CONCRETE DRAGON / ASHLANE — PART PACKS WAVE 5: ARENAS + WEAPONS + HUMANS + ENVIRONMENTS + ANIMATIONS (owner directive 2026-10-06, EXPANDED by parent 2026-10-06). Hunt open-source packs (CC0 or CC-BY ONLY — verify license from source page; NO GPL/AGPL, NO Mixamo/Adobe-restricted, NO non-commercial). TARGET: 200-500 models total across all categories. Prioritize big CC0/CC-BY packs to hit volume fast, then fill gaps with singles.
CATEGORIES:
1. WRESTLING STRUCTURES: rings, steel cages, MMA octagon cages, cell structures, crowd barriers, ring skirts/aprons, turnbuckles. IP law: "hell in a cell" is WWE trademark — in-game names ORIGINAL (e.g. "steel cell").
2. WEAPONS: tables, ladders, chairs, kendo sticks, sledgehammers, baseball bats, trash cans, chains, pipes, bricks. RESEARCH FIRST: document weapon lists from WWE games, Urban Reign, Tekken, Yakuza, Sleeping Dogs in docs/PART_ATTACH_SPEC.md, then hunt FREE 3D models of GENERIC equivalents.
3. HUMANS FOR ASHLANE: street-wrestler-type humanoids, brawlers, crowd NPCs — stage in for-ashlane/ subdirectory (AshLane repo, not Concrete Dragon).
4. CHARACTERS + ANIMATIONS: animated character packs with fight animations (punches, kicks, grapples, taunts, hit reactions, knockdowns, getups) — prioritize real animation clips.
5. ENVIRONMENTS: buildings, city pieces (walls, doors, windows, rooftops, alleys), street props (dumpsters, cars, lamps, fences, crates), interiors (furniture, bars, gyms), anything fitting street brawler / wrestling game.
SOURCES: OpenGameArt deep search, Sketchfab CC (account exists — downloads need browser session; STAGE WHAT YOU CAN GET WITHOUT LOGIN, list Sketchfab finds with URLs + licenses for browser pull), Kenney, Quaternius, Poly Pizza, itch.io, KayKit GitHub (KayKit-Game-Assets org).
STAGE in ~/workspace/street-brawl-cicd/game/assets/staging/parts/<pack>/ with per-pack LICENSE.md; update docs/PART_ATTACH_SPEC.md (§11) + PULL_INS_LOG.md; track count per category in staging log.
IP LAW: inspired-by archetypes only. Research may name games; IN-GAME content uses original names only.
HEARTBEAT after every pack. Mark "done" at end; report pack list + licenses + gap log + category counts.
notes: 2026-10-07: 4 Kenney packs staged (326 GLBs): car-kit(50), city-kit-commercial(41), city-kit-roads(95), furniture-kit(140). 5 more Kenney packs rate-limited (retry later). Drive quota-blocked for Quaternius. Now: Poly Pizza + OGA hunt.
